AGENDA
  GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  COUNCIL CHAMBER, City Hall – 613 E Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for
purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at
http://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. If you have any question about matters on the
agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business
hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language
translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day
upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that
are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the
Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize
the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-
2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require
translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their
own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  FEBRUARY 12, 2019
  ROLL CALL
  1. CLOSED SESSION – 1:00 p.m. (To Commence at 3:00 p.m.)
  a. Conference with Labor Negotiators. The City-designated negotiators attending
  the closed session are: Yasmin Beers, Roubik Golanian, Michael J. Garcia, Gillian
  van Muyden, Matt Doyle, Robert Elliot, and Michele Flynn. The name of the
  employee organizations are: Glendale City Employees' Association and Glendale
  Management Association. Unrepresented Employees: Confidential Employees.

  2. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 6:00 p.m.
  Roll Call
  a. Flag Salute: Council Member Gharpetian
  b. Invocation: Jim Bevacqua, Pastor, Holy Family Catholic Church
  c. Report of City Clerk, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the February 12, 2019
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale City Council was Posted on Friday, February 8,
  2019, on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

  3. PRESENTATIONS AND APPOINTMENTS
  a. Agenda Preview for the Meetings of Tuesday, February 19, 2019

  4. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are Routine and May be Acted Upon by One Motion. Any Member of Council
  or the Audience Requesting Separate Consideration May do so by Making Such Request
  Before Motion is Proposed.
  TYPED 2/4/2019 8:42 AM
  2 12 19
  CC
  1
   a. Minutes of the Special City Council Meetings of January 29, 2019 and February 5,
  2019 and Regular City Council Meeting of February 5, 2019
  b. General Manager of Glendale Water and Power, re: Specification No. 3783, to
  Furnish Materials, Equipment, and Labor for Testing Transformer Oil, Regulator
  Oil, and Circuit Breaker Oil
  1. Resolution Adopting Spec. No. 3783 and Directing the City Clerk to Advertise for Bids
  c. General Manager of Glendale Water and Power, re: Specification No. 3643R for the
  Upgrade of the Grandview Pump House Switchgear for 12.47 kV Operation
  1. Resolution Adopting Spec. No. 3643R and Directing the City Clerk to Advertise for
  Bids
  d. General Manager of Glendale Water and Power, re: Summary Vacation of the City
  of Glendale’s Electrical Easements on the Property Located at 1110 Sonora
  Avenue
  1. Resolution Ordering the Summary Vacation of the Electrical Easements
  e. General Manager of Glendale Water and Power, re: Summary Vacation of a Portion
  of the City of Glendale’s Electrical Easements on the Properties Located at 1412-
  1422 Fifth Street and 1116 Sonora Avenue
  1. Resolution Ordering the Summary Vacation of a Portion of the Electrical Easements
  f. General Manager of Glendale Water and Power and Chief Information Officer, re:
  Amendment to an Agreement with En Pointe Technologies Sales, LLC (En Pointe)
  to Add Direct Support Hours for One-Time IT Infrastructure Upgrades, and
  Additional Annual Remote Managed Services for Glendale Water and Power
  Department (GWP) Disaster Recovery and Electric and Water Supervisory Control
  and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Systems
  1. Motion Authorizing Amendment No. 1 to an Agreement with En Pointe to Add 1,632
  Hours of Direct Support for One-Time IT Infrastructure Upgrades in the Amount of
  $326,400 and Two Years of Additional Remote Managed Services for GWP Disaster
  Recovery and Electric and Water SCADA in an Amount of $924,990
  g. Public Works, re: City of Glendale Measure R Sub-Regional Program Update
  1. Motion Approving Additional Programming, Modifications to Existing Programming,
  and Funding Changes to the Adopted Measure R Sub-Regional Program
  h. Director of Community Services and Parks, re: Acceptance of Additional Los
  Angeles County, Workforce Development, Aging, and Community Services
  (WDACS) 2018-2019 Funds in the Amount of $125,000 to the Verdugo Workforce
  Development Board (VWDB) for Youth Employment Services and Approval of
  VWDB’s Funding Recommendations to the Glendale Youth Alliance (GYA)
  1. Motion Authorizing the Acceptance of Additional Youth Employment funds from the
  Los Angeles County, WDACS Department in the Amount of $125,000 to enable the
  VWDB to distribute $115,725 to the GYA to Provide Youth Employment Services; and
  Approving Award of $115,725 WDACS Youth Funds to the GYA, as Approved and
  Recommended by the VWDB; and Authorizing the City Manager to Execute all
  Agreements, Certifications, and Documents Necessary to Accept and Implement
  Funding
  i. Director of Community Services and Parks, re: Request to Approve Second
  Addendum Lease Agreement between the City of Glendale and Babak B. Golbahar
  for the Verdugo Jobs Center Facility Located at 1255 South Central Avenue,
  Glendale, CA 91204 for a 5 Year Period from April 1, 2018 to March 31, 2023
  1. Motion Approving a Second Addendum; and Authorizing the City Manager to Execute
  Related Contracts
